meta.name: video-downloader
meta.description: Downloads videos from YouTube and other platforms for offline viewing, editing, or archival. Handles various formats and quality options.

copy.tagline: 下载网络视频到本地离线观看
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把在线视频保存到本地慢慢看
copy.tagline_en: Download online videos for offline viewing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save online videos locally

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以下载 YouTube 等平台的视频到你的电脑，支持选择画质（480p、720p、1080p、4K）和格式（MP4、WebM、仅音频），还能批量下载播放列表。
howto.when: 当你要求下载视频、音频或播放列表，并提供视频链接时触发。

say.text: 把这个视频的音频提取成 MP3
say.note: Claude 会下载仅音频文件。

say.text: 下载这个播放列表里的所有视频
say.note: Claude 会批量下载整个播放列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can download videos from YouTube and other platforms to your computer, supporting quality selection (480p, 720p, 1080p, 4K) and formats (MP4, WebM, audio-only), and can batch download playlists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to download a video, audio, or playlist and provide a video link.

say_en.note: Claude will start downloading and show progress.

say_en.text: Extract the audio from this video as MP3
say_en.note: Claude will download only the audio.

say_en.text: Download all videos from this playlist
say_en.note: Claude will batch download the entire playlist.
